facts.value: Students can use the module for deepening their subject-related skills and knowledge by attending additional courses offered within the elective modules of the Master's programme in Southeast Asian Studies, or to explore subject areas of other disciplines with special reference to their semester abroad.
facts.original_value: Students of version 2 can choose between two possibilities: a) They can use the module for deepening their subject-related skills and knowledge by attending additional courses offered within the elective modules (SEAS 5, 6, 7 or 8) of the Master's programme in Southeast Asian Studies, or b) They can use the module to explore subject areas of other disciplines with special reference to their semester abroad.

facts.value: Possible courses are part of faculty 09 (Linguistic and Cultural Studies) or part of study programs from other faculties, subject to reciprocal agreements of services for minor-teaching between the faculty 09 and other mentioned faculties.
facts.original_value: Possible courses are 1. part of the faculty 09 (Linguistic and Cultural Studies) or 2. part of study programs from other faculties, subject to reciprocal agreements of services for minor-teaching between the faculty 09 and other mentioned faculties.

facts.value: The conclusion of the module has to be attested by the module coordinator.
facts.original_value: The conclusion of the module has to be attested by the module coordinator.
